name: cuberhyk-dev-flow
description: A compact Codex lifecycle workflow plugin with orient, decision, exploratory review, branch, changelog, distill, and review gates.

interface.shortDescription: Init, check, orient, plan, audit, exploratory review, branch, changelog, and distill coding work.
interface.longDescription: cuberhyk-dev-flow provides nine focused Codex skills. dev-plan and dev-audit include low-noise orientation gates, while dev-exploratory-review maps unknown risks and verifies realistic failures. dev-branch executes work inside a reviewed Git branch and runs changelog, distill, and check gates before showing status and diff for approval. dev-check validates repository memory and audit lifecycle health, while dev-orient, dev-changelog, and dev-distill remain available as standalone expert tools.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-init to initialize Dev Flow memory when needed.
Use dev-check to validate docs routing.
Use dev-plan to enter relevant context, identify decision points, and define the next task.
Use dev-audit to enter relevant context, review bounded features or workflows, and persist non-trivial findings.
Use dev-exploratory-review to map a project or scope, build a risk map, run focused probes/tests, and report realistic failures.
Use dev-branch to isolate implementation work, run changelog, distill, and check gates, and wait for review before commit and merge.
Use dev-orient, dev-changelog, and dev-distill standalone only when a context-only, release-note-only, or knowledge-only task needs them.
